"""Public redirect endpoint (registered last so fixed routes win)."""

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Path
from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse

from service.api.deps import get_link_service
from service.links import LinkService

router = APIRouter(tags=["redirect"])


@router.get(
    "/{code}",
    status_code=302,
    response_class=RedirectResponse,
    responses={404: {"description": "Unknown code"}, 410: {"description": "Expired or disabled"}},
)
async def follow(
    code: Annotated[str, Path(min_length=1, max_length=64)],
    service: Annotated[LinkService, Depends(get_link_service)],
) -> RedirectResponse:
    link = await service.resolve(code)
    return RedirectResponse(
        link.target_url,
        status_code=service.settings.redirect_status_code,
        headers={"Cache-Control": "private, no-store"},
    )

"""Link use cases: create (idempotent), resolve, read, update, soft-delete."""

import hashlib
import json

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from service.config import Settings
from service.db import utcnow
from service.domain.codes import AliasError, generate_code, normalize_alias
from service.domain.urls import UrlError, normalize_url
from service.errors import ConflictError, GoneError, InvalidInputError, NotFoundError
from service.models import Link
from service.observability import get_logger
from service.repository import LinkRepository
from service.schemas import LinkCreate, LinkOut, LinkUpdate

log = get_logger("links")


def fingerprint(payload: LinkCreate) -> str:
    canonical = json.dumps(payload.model_dump(mode="json"), sort_keys=True)
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()


class LinkService:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession, settings: Settings) -> None:
        self.session = session
        self.settings = settings
        self.repo = LinkRepository(session)

    def to_out(self, link: Link) -> LinkOut:
        return LinkOut(
            code=link.code,
            short_url=f"{self.settings.base_url}/{link.code}",
            target_url=link.target_url,
            is_custom=link.is_custom,
            tags=list(link.tags or []),
            disabled=link.disabled,
            created_at=link.created_at,
            updated_at=link.updated_at,
        )

    async def create(
        self, payload: LinkCreate, idempotency_key: str | None = None
    ) -> tuple[Link, bool]:
        """Return ``(link, created)``; ``created`` is False for an idempotent replay."""
        try:
            target = normalize_url(
                payload.url,
                max_length=self.settings.max_url_length,
                allow_private=self.settings.allow_private_hosts,
            )
        except UrlError as exc:
            raise InvalidInputError(str(exc)) from exc
        digest = fingerprint(payload)
        if idempotency_key:
            replay = await self._replay(idempotency_key, digest)
            if replay is not None:
                return replay, False

        if payload.custom_alias is not None:
            try:
                alias = normalize_alias(payload.custom_alias)
            except AliasError as exc:
                raise InvalidInputError(str(exc)) from exc
            if await self.repo.alias_taken(alias):
                raise ConflictError(f"alias '{payload.custom_alias}' is already taken")
            candidates = [alias]
        else:
            candidates = [
                generate_code(self.settings.code_length)
                for _ in range(self.settings.code_max_attempts)
            ]

        for code in candidates:
            if payload.custom_alias is None and await self.repo.code_exists(code):
                log.info("code collision, retrying", extra={"code_length": len(code)})
                continue
            link = Link(
                code=code,
                target_url=target,
                is_custom=payload.custom_alias is not None,
                tags=list(payload.tags),
                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
                request_fingerprint=digest if idempotency_key else None,
            )
            try:
                await self.repo.add(link)
                await self.session.commit()
            except IntegrityError:
                await self.session.rollback()
                if idempotency_key:
                    replay = await self._replay(idempotency_key, digest)
                    if replay is not None:
                        return replay, False
                if payload.custom_alias is not None:
                    raise ConflictError(
                        f"alias '{payload.custom_alias}' is already taken"
                    ) from None
                continue
            log.info("link created", extra={"code": link.code, "custom": link.is_custom})
            return link, True
        raise ConflictError("could not allocate a unique code; please retry")

    async def _replay(self, key: str, digest: str) -> Link | None:
        existing = await self.repo.get_by_idempotency_key(key)
        if existing is None:
            return None
        if existing.request_fingerprint != digest:
            raise ConflictError("Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body")
        return existing

    async def resolve(self, code: str) -> Link:
        """Look up a link for redirecting; raises 404 for unknown and 410 for gone links."""
        link = await self.repo.get_by_code(code)
        if link is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no link with code '{code}'")
        if link.deleted_at is not None or link.disabled:
            raise GoneError(f"link '{code}' is no longer available")
        return link

    async def get(self, code: str) -> Link:
        link = await self.repo.get_by_code(code)
        if link is None or link.deleted_at is not None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no link with code '{code}'")
        return link

    async def update(self, code: str, patch: LinkUpdate) -> Link:
        link = await self.get(code)
        if patch.disabled is not None:
            link.disabled = patch.disabled
        link.updated_at = utcnow()
        await self.session.commit()
        return link

    async def delete(self, code: str) -> None:
        link = await self.get(code)
        link.deleted_at = utcnow()
        link.updated_at = link.deleted_at
        await self.session.commit()
        log.info("link deleted", extra={"code": code})

"""Data access for links."""

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from service.models import Link


class LinkRepository:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def get_by_code(self, code: str) -> Link | None:
        result = await self.session.execute(select(Link).where(Link.code == code))
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def code_exists(self, code: str) -> bool:
        result = await self.session.execute(select(Link.id).where(Link.code == code))
        return result.first() is not None

    async def alias_taken(self, alias: str) -> bool:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Link.id).where(func.lower(Link.code) == alias.lower())
        )
        return result.first() is not None

    async def get_by_idempotency_key(self, key: str) -> Link | None:
        result = await self.session.execute(select(Link).where(Link.idempotency_key == key))
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def add(self, link: Link) -> Link:
        self.session.add(link)
        await self.session.flush()
        return link

"""Public API models."""

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Annotated

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, StringConstraints, model_validator

Tag = Annotated[str, StringConstraints(min_length=1, max_length=32, pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")]


class LinkCreate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    url: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8192, examples=["https://example.com/docs"])
    custom_alias: str | None = Field(None, max_length=64, examples=["launch-2026"])
    tags: list[Tag] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=10)


class LinkUpdate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    disabled: bool | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _not_empty(self) -> "LinkUpdate":
        if not self.model_fields_set:
            raise ValueError("at least one field must be provided")
        return self


class LinkOut(BaseModel):
    code: str
    short_url: str
    target_url: str
    is_custom: bool
    tags: list[str]
    disabled: bool
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime

from httpx import AsyncClient

from service.config import Settings


async def create(client: AsyncClient, **body: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    resp = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://example.com/a", **body})
    assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
    return resp.json()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]


async def test_create_returns_201_with_short_url(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://Example.com/docs", "tags": ["launch"]}
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    body = resp.json()
    assert len(body["code"]) == 7
    assert body["short_url"] == f"http://sho.rt/{body['code']}"
    assert body["target_url"] == "https://example.com/docs"
    assert body["tags"] == ["launch"]
    assert body["created_at"]
    assert resp.headers["Location"] == f"/api/v1/links/{body['code']}"


async def test_redirect_follows_with_302_and_no_store(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    link = await create(client)
    resp = await client.get(f"/{link['code']}")
    assert resp.status_code == 302
    assert resp.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/a"
    assert resp.headers["cache-control"] == "private, no-store"


async def test_unknown_code_is_404(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.get("/doesnotexist")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "not_found"


async def test_invalid_urls_are_rejected_with_422(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    for url in ("javascript:alert(1)", "http://127.0.0.1/", "not a url"):
        resp = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": url})
        assert resp.status_code == 422
        assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_input"


async def test_schema_validation_errors_use_envelope(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    resp = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com", "surprise": 1})
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"
    bad_tags = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com", "tags": ["a b"]})
    assert bad_tags.status_code == 422


async def test_custom_alias_and_conflict(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    link = await create(client, custom_alias="launch-2026")
    assert link["code"] == "launch-2026"
    assert link["is_custom"] is True
    dup = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com", "custom_alias": "launch-2026"}
    )
    assert dup.status_code == 409
    reserved = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com", "custom_alias": "api"}
    )
    assert reserved.status_code == 422


async def test_idempotency_key_replays_and_detects_misuse(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    headers = {"Idempotency-Key": "req-42"}
    first = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com/x"}, headers=headers)
    again = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com/x"}, headers=headers)
    assert first.status_code == again.status_code == 201
    assert first.json()["code"] == again.json()["code"]
    assert again.headers["Idempotent-Replayed"] == "true"
    misuse = await client.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com/y"}, headers=headers)
    assert misuse.status_code == 409


async def test_metadata_patch_and_soft_delete(client: AsyncClient) -> None:
    link = await create(client)
    code = link["code"]
    meta = await client.get(f"/api/v1/links/{code}")
    assert meta.status_code == 200
    assert meta.json()["disabled"] is False

    disabled = await client.patch(f"/api/v1/links/{code}", json={"disabled": True})
    assert disabled.json()["disabled"] is True
    assert (await client.get(f"/{code}")).status_code == 410
    await client.patch(f"/api/v1/links/{code}", json={"disabled": False})
    assert (await client.get(f"/{code}")).status_code == 302

    empty = await client.patch(f"/api/v1/links/{code}", json={})
    assert empty.status_code == 422

    assert (await client.delete(f"/api/v1/links/{code}")).status_code == 204
    assert (await client.get(f"/api/v1/links/{code}")).status_code == 404
    assert (await client.get(f"/{code}")).status_code == 410
    assert (await client.delete(f"/api/v1/links/{code}")).status_code == 404


async def test_redirect_status_is_configurable(settings: Settings) -> None:
    from httpx import ASGITransport

    from service.app import create_app

    app = create_app(settings.model_copy(update={"redirect_status_code": 307}))
    async with (
        app.router.lifespan_context(app),
        AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://t") as c,
    ):
        code = (await c.post("/api/v1/links", json={"url": "https://e.com"})).json()["code"]
        assert (await c.get(f"/{code}")).status_code == 307

content.rationale: LinkService holds the use cases; the repository isolates SQL. Create supports Idempotency-Key with a request fingerprint (replay returns the original link, misuse returns 409). Redirect returns 302 by default (307 configurable) with Cache-Control no-store so every click reaches the service. Custom aliases are stored in canonical lower case and alias conflicts are checked case-insensitively. NOTE (deliberate, documented): lookups use exact matching, so an alias created as 'MyLink' is not reachable at /MyLink. This is the seeded defect fixed by the brownfield scenario.
